headline: 10 dead as avalanche kills climber Nirmal Purja on Broad Peak
summary: The body of the world-renowned British-Nepali climber was recovered by rescuers from one of the world's highest peaks in northern Pakistan.
details: Rescuers have recovered the body of world-renowned climber Nirmal Purja after a devastating avalanche struck on Broad Peak in northern Pakistan.
The avalanche occurred on Thursday, claiming the lives of Purja and nine other team members during an international expedition.
The 43-year-old British-Nepali climber was found by a ground rescue team at approximately 5,700 meters on the mountain.
According to the Alpine Club of Pakistan, the rescue team is transporting four bodies down from the mountain, including Purja, two other Nepali nationals, and a Chinese citizen.
General secretary Ayaz Shigri confirmed that rescuers have also located one additional body at a significantly higher elevation.
caption:
A mountain he loved has taken him. World-renowned climber Nirmal Purja and 9 others killed in a Broad Peak avalanche.

Rescuers have recovered the body of world-renowned climber Nirmal Purja after a devastating avalanche struck on Broad Peak in northern Pakistan.

The avalanche occurred on Thursday, claiming the lives of Purja and nine other team members during an international expedition.

The 43-year-old British-Nepali climber was found by a ground rescue team at approximately 5,700 meters on the mountain.

According to the Alpine Club of Pakistan, the rescue team is transporting four bodies down from the mountain, including Purja, two other Nepali nationals, and a Chinese citizen.

General secretary Ayaz Shigri confirmed that rescuers have also located one additional body at a significantly higher elevation.

headline_marked: Govt hires law firm to [[bring ex-IGP Benazir Ahmed home]] from UAE
headline: Govt hires law firm to bring ex-IGP Benazir Ahmed home from UAE
summary: The Bangladesh government has appointed a legal team to cancel Benazir's bail and facilitate his repatriation from the United Arab Emirates.
details: The Bangladesh government has initiated the process to repatriate former Inspector General of Police (IGP) Benazir Ahmed from the United Arab Emirates (UAE).
Home Minister Humaiun Kobir stated that a law firm has been appointed to seek the cancellation of Benazir's bail in the UAE to ensure his return.
State Minister for Foreign Affairs Shama Obaid expressed optimism that the former police chief will be brought back to Bangladesh soon.
The move comes amid reports that Benazir had previously been released from prison in Dubai, sparking a fresh effort by the government to secure his repatriation.
The government is coordinating with UAE authorities to ensure the legal process is followed for the extradition of the former IGP.
caption:
A law firm has been hired to cancel the bail of ex-IGP Benazir Ahmed and bring him back to Bangladesh from the UAE.

The Bangladesh government has initiated the process to repatriate former Inspector General of Police (IGP) Benazir Ahmed from the United Arab Emirates (UAE).

Home Minister Humaiun Kobir stated that a law firm has been appointed to seek the cancellation of Benazir's bail in the UAE to ensure his return.

State Minister for Foreign Affairs Shama Obaid expressed optimism that the former police chief will be brought back to Bangladesh soon.

The move comes amid reports that Benazir had previously been released from prison in Dubai, sparking a fresh effort by the government to secure his repatriation.

The government is coordinating with UAE authorities to ensure the legal process is followed for the extradition of the former IGP.
